svg.title: Lookout architecture
svg.desc: Human edits and approvals persist in the workspace. An optional polling watcher wakes the external personal agent, which resumes through scoped MCP reads. Workspace capabilities are logical modules.
svg.text: Lookout: shared workspace for ongoing human-agent workflows
Versions, scoped writes, durable workflow coordination
Queued work or polling / wake coordination
Boundaries are logical responsibilities, not a claim of separately deployed microservices. Wake delivery depends on the agent host.
